blocks.text: Once the report spreads, the Mughals laid a siege to the Mansion and tried to turn numbers, walls, and gun positions into a substitute for bravery in open combat.
They raised mud walls and large obstructions around the place, hoping that hunger would do what courage had not, until whatever provisions they had had been consumed inside the enclosure.

The turning point comes unexpectedly when a fierce blinding storm and heavy rain set in, and under that cover The Singhs ran out wielding swords to break the siege that had been tightening around them.
